name: Monologin
source:
...What if the only place you felt "real" was in a game nobody played anymore?

In [b]Monologin[/b], a short psychological horror visual novel, you take the role of Leo, a directionless night-shift convenience store worker... Leo clings to an old, dying MMORPG as proof that his life still means something.

Everyone else seems to have moved on... College, relationships, all that kind of stuff.

But Leo still logs into [b]EdenVale Online[/b].

Once played by millions, now barely kept alive by a few stubborn veterans. EdenVale is home to Leo’s one remaining obsession: obtaining the legendary [b]White Unicorn[/b] mount.

During a quiet night shift, old friends pass through the store: [b]Ari[/b], [b]Dai[/b], [b]Piko[/b], and [b]Uma[/b]. Each brief encounter leaves Leo feeling judged, pitied, rejected... Left behind.

...As the night unfolds, the same moments begin to take on different meanings. Casual jokes become missed invitations. Polite distance hides crises. Success looks less like victory...

...And somewhere inside EdenVale, the forgotten [b]White Unicorn[/b] event is about to begin.

Through subtle dialogue choices and shifting emotional responses, decide whether Leo deals with his own insecurity... How he avoids the connections in front of him, or briefly recognizes that everyone around him is more real than he wanted to admit.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4692700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
…如果你唯一感觉“真实”的地方是在无人玩的游戏中怎么办？

在[b]Monologin[/b]，一部简短的心理恐怖视觉小说中，你扮演Leo，一个没有方向的夜班便利店员工……Leo坚持使用一款古老的、垂死的MMORPG，以此来证明他的生命仍然有意义。

其他人似乎都已经向前迈进了……大学、人际关系，诸如此类的事情。

但Leo仍然登录 [b]EdenVale Online[/b]。

曾经有数百万人玩过，现在只有少数顽固的老玩家勉强维持生命。伊甸谷是Leo唯一痴迷的家园：获得传奇的[b]白色独角兽[/b]坐骑。

在安静的夜班期间，老朋友经过商店：[b]Ari[/b]、[b]Dai[/b]、[b]Piko[/b] 和 [b]Uma[/b]。每一次短暂的相遇都会让狮子座感到被评判、被怜悯、被拒绝……被抛在后面。

……随着夜幕降临，同样的时刻开始呈现出不同的含义。随意的笑话变成了错过的邀请。礼貌的距离隐藏着危机。成功看起来不太像胜利……

…在伊甸谷的某个地方，被遗忘的[b]白色独角兽[/b]事件即将开始。

通过微妙的对话选择和不断变化的情绪反应，决定狮子座是否应对自己的不安全感……他如何避免面前的联系，或者短暂地认识到他周围的每个人都比他想承认的更真实。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4692700/]Steam[/url]]
